description: Lignes et arrêts de bus - CCPHVA is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté de communes Pays Haut Val d'Alzette. Ce jeu de données référence les différentes lignes qui desservent le territoire de la Communauté de communes Pays Haut Val d'Alzette, ainsi que les arrêts de bus que desservent ces lignes. Coverage: Communauté de communes Pays Haut Val d'Alzette. The publisher named on the listing is Communauté de communes Pays Haut Val d'Alzette. Its keywords include mobilite, bus, arrets. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2025-07-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
